title: Gene expression and anticancer evaluation of Kigelia africana (Lam.) Benth. Extracts using MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 cell lines.
authors: Kalsoom, Aasia; Altaf, Awais; Sattar, Huma; Maqbool, Tahir; Sajjad, Muhammad; Jilani, Muhammad Idrees; Shabbir, Ghulam; Aftab, Saira
one_liner_zh: 该文评估非洲吊灯树提取物的抗癌活性，涉及基因表达和分子对接，但核心是植物提取物细胞毒性，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接针对蛋白-配体，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: In recent years, a cancer research trend has shifted towards identifying novel therapeutic compounds from natural assets for the management of cancer. In this study, we aimed to assess the cytotoxic activity of Kigelia Africana (KA) extracts on breast cancer (MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7) and noncancerous kidney cells (HEK-293T) to develop an efficient anticancer medication. We used gas chromatography mass spectrometry (GC-MS to analyze the constituents of EKA and HKA extracts meanwhile the crystal violet and the MTT (3-(4,5-Dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-Diphenyltetrazolium Bromide) assays were used to examine the possible cytotoxic effects of plant extracts on our cancer cell lines along with non-cancerous control. The quantitative real-time PCR (RT-PCR) was run on cell samples to evaluate the differential expression of cell proliferative markers of cancer (BCL-2 and TP53). These phytochemicals have been reported to have binding affinity for some other growth factors and receptors as well which was evaluated by the in-silico molecular docking against Bcl2, EGFR, HER2, and TP53. Our Morphological observation showed a significant difference in the cell morphology and proliferation potential which was decreased under the effect of plant extracts treatment as compared to the control samples. The ethanol extract exhibited a marked antiproliferative activity towards MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 cell lines with IC50 = 20 and 32 mug/mL, respectively. Quantitative RT-PCR gene expression investigation revealed that the IC50 concentration of ethanolic extract regulated the levels of mRNA expression of apoptotic genes. With the target and active binding site amino acids discovered in the molecular docking investigation, TP53/Propanoic acid, 3-(2, 3, 6-trimethyl-1, 4-dioxaspiro [4.4] non-7-yl)-, methyl ester (-7.1 kcal/mol) is the best-docked ligand. The use of this plant in folk remedies justifies its high in vitro anti-cancer capabilities. This work highlights the role of phytochemicals in the inhibition of cancer proliferation. Based on all these findings, it can be concluded that EKA extract has promising anti-proliferative effect on cancerous cells but more study is required in future to further narrow down the active ingredients of total crude extract with specific targets in cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 近年来，癌症研究的一个趋势转向从自然资源中寻找新型治疗化合物以管理癌症。在本研究中，我们旨在评估Kigelia Africana（KA）提取物对乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231和MCF-7）及非癌性肾细胞（HEK-293T）的细胞毒性活性，以开发一种有效的抗癌药物。我们使用气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析EKA和HKA提取物的成分，同时采用结晶紫和MTT（3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物）实验检测植物提取物对我们癌细胞系及非癌性对照的潜在细胞毒性效应。对细胞样本进行定量实时PCR（RT-PCR）以评估癌症细胞增殖标志物（BCL-2和TP53）的差异表达。这些植物化学物质据报道对某些其他生长因子和受体也具有结合亲和力，这通过针对Bcl2、EGFR、HER2和TP53的计算机分子对接（in-silico molecular docking）进行了评估。我们的形态学观察显示，与对照样本相比，植物提取物处理下细胞形态和增殖潜力存在显著差异，且增殖能力降低。乙醇提取物对MDA-MB-231和MCF-7细胞系表现出显著的抗增殖活性，IC50分别为20和32 μg/mL。定量RT-PCR基因表达研究揭示，乙醇提取物的IC50浓度调节了凋亡基因mRNA表达水平。在分子对接研究中发现的目标和活性结合位点氨基酸中，TP53/丙酸，3-(2,3,6-三甲基-1,4-二氧杂螺[4.4]壬-7-基)-，甲酯（-7.1 kcal/mol）是最佳对接配体。该植物在民间疗法中的使用证明了其高体外抗癌能力。这项工作强调了植物化学物质在抑制癌症增殖中的作用。基于所有这些发现，可以得出结论，EKA提取物对癌细胞具有有前景的抗增殖效应，但未来需要更多研究以进一步缩小总粗提取物中针对癌细胞特定靶点的活性成分范围。
